question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Deficient
solution:
The correct answer is **"Insufficient."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deficient** means lacking in some essential quality or element. (किसी आवश्यक गुण या तत्व की कमी होना)

 
 
• **Example**: *The company's budget was **deficient,**__ so they had to cut back on expenses.*
 
 
 
• **Insufficient** is a synonym of deficient, meaning not enough or inadequate. (अपर्याप्त, नाकाफ़ी)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The students complained that they were given **insufficient**__ time for the test.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2 (Sufficient)** means enough or adequate, which is the opposite of deficient. (जितना आवश्‍यक हो उतना; पर्याप्त)
 
• **Option 3 (Distinct)** means clear or easily distinguishable, which is not related to deficient. (स्‍पष्‍ट; सुव्‍यक्त)
 
• **Option 4 (Abundant)** means plentiful or overflowing, which is the opposite of deficient. (प्रचुर या भरपूर)

180:T4fd,The correct answer is** "No error."**
